notte-dress.title: NOTTE DRESS
notte-dress.descriptionHtml:
A high-neck column gown in black crepe. Beading traces the stand collar, full balloon sleeves gather into a narrow cuff, and a lace belt defines the waist before the skirt falls long and straight.

Part of Noctra, the Fall/Winter 26/27 collection by Reina Reichouni.

prima-set.title: PRIMA SET
prima-set.descriptionHtml:
A two-piece suit. The blazer is collarless and asymmetric, fastened with a single sculpted button, with flared cuffs and a curved hem that soften its precise lines. The trousers are high-waisted and wide-leg, with a pressed crease and a long, clean line.

The set includes the blazer and the trousers.

Part of Noctra, the Fall/Winter 26/27 collection by Reina Reichouni.

rose-top.title: ROSE TOP
rose-top.descriptionHtml:
A high neck and full bishop sleeves, drawn in at the waist by a lace belt that ties in a soft bow at the back. Quiet and composed, made for the hours after dark.

Part of Noctra, the Fall/Winter 26/27 collection by Reina Reichouni.

noctra-blazer.title: NOCTRA BLAZER
noctra-blazer.descriptionHtml:
Glossy croc-embossed tailoring in deep oxblood: a wide notch collar, a sculpted waist, and a curtain of fringe across the back that reveals itself as you leave.

Part of Noctra, the Fall/Winter 26/27 collection by Reina Reichouni.

brezza-set.title: BREZZA SET
brezza-set.descriptionHtml:
A two-piece set. The Brezza kimono is a cropped caped top with batwing sleeves, braided trim at the neck and cuffs, and a keyhole at the back closed with covered buttons. The Brezza skirt is a high-waisted maxi with a smooth yoke that opens into deep gathers and a sweeping hem.

The set includes the kimono and the skirt.

Part of Noctra, the Fall/Winter 26/27 collection by Reina Reichouni.
